dimensions.assessment: Applies directly to specific non-U.S. nationals associated with specified militant groups or the October 7 attacks, as well as all members of the Palestine Liberation Organization.
dimensions.evidence: Any alien who carried out, participated in, planned, financed, afforded material support to, or otherwise facilitated any of the attacks against Israel... is inadmissible.

dimensions.assessment: Denies admission, immigration-related relief, and asylum protections, leading to severe and life-changing removal or exclusion outcomes for affected individuals.
dimensions.evidence: shall be ineligible for any relief under the immigration laws, including under this section, section 208, and section 2242

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative reporting duties for the Department of Homeland Security with negligible direct fiscal or economic impact stated.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Homeland Security shall submit a report to Congress, including the number of aliens who were found to be inadmissible

dimensions.assessment: Amends foundational federal immigration statutes by altering admission, removability, and relief criteria under the Immigration and Nationality Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 212(a)(3) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(3)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory amendments to immigration law alongside ongoing annual reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Beginning not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, and each year thereafter, the Secretary of Homeland Security shall submit a report

missing_information: Exact numbers of individuals who will be affected or found inadmissible
Cost estimates for compiling the required annual reports
importance_detail.rationale: Imposes strict immigration bars and deportability rules on individuals linked to Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, or the October 7, 2023, attacks, and broadens restrictions against PLO members.
